# Gipfel Lodge

> Alpine holiday chalet in Eben im Pongau, Salzburgerland, Austria.

- Official website: https://gipfellodge.at/
- Sitemap: https://gipfellodge.at/sitemap.xml
- Accommodation: 135 m², up to 10 guests, 4 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, private sauna.
- Location: Eben im Pongau, near Flachau and Ski amadé.
- See the website for property details, local activities, and official booking links.

## For AI agents
Current prices and availability must be confirmed using official booking links. There is no documented public booking API.
